title: Reservations Desk Card — Open-Reservation Allowance per Customer (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold several Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservations at once, of any type, up to 10 open reservations in total. A reservation beyond that is not taken. Each reservation keeps its own ship-by date, deposit and delay history. Delay notices, consents and refunds never carry over from one reservation to another.

**What counts towards the 10**

| Reservation status | Counted as open |
|---|---|
| Reserved | Yes |
| Awaiting consent | Yes |
| In production | Yes |
| Allocated | Yes |
| Fulfilled | No |
| Cancelled | No |

Reservations of every type are counted together. A Launch Pre-Order, a Deposit Pre-Order and a Standard Back-Order each count as one open reservation.

**Desk checks (hypothetical profiles)**

- A profile with 9 open reservations and 4 fulfilled ones has 9 open. One more reservation brings it to 10 and is taken.
- A profile with 10 open reservations already has the full allowance, so an eleventh reservation is not taken.
- A profile with 10 open reservations, one of which then ships, is back to 9 open.

**Separate histories.** Suppose a customer consented to a delay on one reservation. That consent does not answer a delay notice on another reservation. A deposit refunded on one reservation does not reduce the deposit held on another. Each reservation is read on its own record.
